# EASTWAY Logistics

> EASTWAY is a global freight forwarder providing tailor-made logistics solutions for
> customers in 50+ industries: ocean (FCL/LCL), air, rail, road, project cargo,
> warehousing and customs brokerage.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://eastway-logistics.vercel.app/): Company overview, services, global reach, insights, FAQ and quote request form.
- [Locations](https://eastway-logistics.vercel.app/location): Gateway offices, air cargo stations and the bonded warehouse network.

## Services

- Marine cargo: FCL/LCL ocean freight, port-to-door handling, customs coordination.
- Air cargo: time-critical airfreight, charter capacity, temperature-controlled cargo.
- Inland cargo: domestic road haulage and cross-border trucking with live tracking.
- Heavy equipment: oversize and project cargo with route surveys and lifting plans.
- Car shipping: RoRo, container and enclosed vehicle transport.
- Container sea cargo: leasing, stuffing, consolidation and demurrage visibility.
